say: [quietly, exhausted] I don't think God is real.
[frustrated] Because I've prayed for YEARS... [voice breaking] and He's never said a single word to me.
[flat, listing] I go to church. I pray. I worship.
[bitter] But no voice. No lightning. [pause] Nothing.
[softer, curious] But what if God isn't silent? [beat] What if I was listening for the wrong thing?
[storyteller, building] Elijah waited for God in the wind. [louder] The earthquake! [intense] And the fire!
cap: Elijah waited for God in the wind… the earthquake… and the fire.

say: [firm] But God wasn't in any of them. [softly] He came... [whispering] in a whisper.
[energetic] So here's how you HEAR Him.
cap: So here's how you HEAR Him.

say: [punchy] H is for History.
[confident] My faith doesn't stand on a feeling. It stands on an empty tomb, seen by over five hundred eyewitnesses.
cap: My faith doesn't stand on a feeling. It stands on an empty tomb, seen by 500+ eyewitnesses.

say: [punchy] E is for Every page.
[amazed] In nineteen forty-seven, scrolls found by the Dead Sea showed Isaiah, copied almost word for word, a thousand years older than any copy we had.
cap: In 1947, scrolls found by the Dead Sea showed Isaiah, copied almost word for word, 1,000 years older than any copy we had.

say: [warm] God kept His word. Read it out loud... and you're hearing His voice.
[punchy] A is for Around you.
[warm, smiling] The friend who texted at the perfect moment. [impressed] The sermon that felt aimed right at me.
[sincere] God speaks through people... more than clouds.
[punchy] R is for Rearview.
[reflective] Look back... and you'll see one red thread through it all. [awed] His fingerprints. Everywhere.
[emotional] He was never silent.
[whispering] He's been whispering this whole time.
[upbeat] Which letter did you need today? Comment H, E, A, or R.
